_comment: Snapshot of the Development Discourses entries that /theories/ pages link to. Development Discourses is a separate repository (Varnasr/development-discourses); this file exists so that a link into it can be validated from here, since scripts/build-theories.py cannot read another repo's data at build time. Regenerate with `python3 scripts/sync-development-discourses.py --repo /path/to/development-discourses`, which reads the ids referenced across data/theories/*.json and refuses to write if any of them has disappeared from the source library.
